baseline: native non-RL multi-label A; signed binary analytic ridge, identity penalty
candidate: local_transport; same native A plus per-label binary four-region inverse ridge prior
fit_meta: all current task images enter native A optimizer and boundary statistics; no internal meta/controller
mask: all introduced labels known; future labels masked unknown and zeroed before callers
allocation: earliest task containing any positive label; cumulative known-label mask
bank: per label and binary sign: n, global feature sum, global second moment; positive/negative local four means
global_transport: original current observed-pair weighted common feature shift
local_transport: same observed-pair row weights for each of four current region shifts; move existing supported binary centers, then count-weighted add current means
local_pool: original double-branch CLS-conditioned four spatial regions; remove image region mean; unit normalize
local_prior: for each label, P=[supported positive/negative four unit centers]/2; R=(I+P P^T)^(-1); augmented penalty=diag(R,1)
missing_sign_rule: native ridge balances only available binary signs; inactive label head zero; absent local signs omitted; all undefined support disclosed
candidate_only_change: binary analytic ridge feature penalty and corresponding transported local aggregate evidence; BCE/FD10/AdamW/clip unchanged
primary_metric: mAP of currently introduced labels, AP undefined only without observed validation positives
forgetting: mean over final old labels of max earlier introduced-stage AP minus final AP; may be negative
validation_masks: all 640 official validation images, cumulative visible labels; never meta or optimizer data
final_support_mask: all 29 labels AP and AUROC definable; earlier future labels report null with zero observed support
success_claim: descriptive paired development evidence; no imported single-label BA gate or clinical success claim
cost_policy: 2 preflight+2 train+2 evaluate occurrences retained separately; CPU prep/check and parallel wall separate; no cumulative double counting
old_label_current_positive_rule: earliest-positive allocation yields zero old-label positives in later tasks; previous positive aggregate evidence retained
